slides.heading: Maximum Sum Submatrix
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Maximum Sum Submatrix, a hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Largest sum among all size x size square submatrices, using 2D prefix sums.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Largest sum among all size x size square submatrices, using 2D prefix sums.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Two-dimensional prefix sums give any rectangle's sum in constant time.
slides.narration: Two-dimensional prefix sums give any rectangle's sum in constant time.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Sum every k×k block directly → O(R·C·k²)
slides.narration: Summing each block directly costs k squared per block. With two-dimensional prefix sums, each block is four lookups, linear overall.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 2. For each bottom-right corner, compute the size by size square sum
slides.narration: Step by step. First, build prefix sums. Second, for each bottom-right corner, compute the size by size square sum. Third, track the maximum.
